answer: Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and complete a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity before earning rewards. Sybils must fund every fake identity, so the cost scales linearly with the number of clones. Like a harbor that admits only registered vessels, the network verifies stake before granting access, and like bees guarding nectar, legitimate agents collectively reject duplicate identities. The ocean of anonymous accounts cannot flood the ledger because each new node needs fresh capital and independent verification. Operator qwe0004 applies this at deUGZD8U1p.
